Worked well, my skin was so clear and bright. Recently, I ran out and went to buy more of the anti-wrinkle toner, but couldn't find it anywhere on the site. I won't be buying this one again, now trying to decide whether to toss it or what...

avis.titre: Good purchase... Great toner for my skin!

It evens out my skin by getting rid of dead skin cells and it helps prepare my skin for my serums & moisturizers. I notice that my skin absorbs serums & moisturizers much better these days. This is definitely a good addition to my skincare routine.
I use it occasionally when I feel the skin on my face needs extra help. It works nicely and the smell is pleasant. My skin looks and feels more refined after using it.

I don't like the smell at all, sadly I rinsed it down the sink. I only bought it because you have been out of my favorite one for months.
I love this toner. I use it nightly and pat it on my clean face with my hands. Combined with the Vitamin A serum, it gives me such a smooth and soft skin the next day.
I use this refreshing radiance toner every morning, I needed something with AHA and organic and this has both qualities.

avis.titre: I have purchased over and over
avis.texte: Love this ! Not only does it clear the pores but I do believe it has reduced the bumps that sometimes appear

avis.titre: I've gone through two bottles so far!
avis.texte: Note: My first bottle of this toner was free in exchange for social media posts. Since then, I have bought it twice. I'm almost done with my second bottle, which is why I had to buy the Essentials Radiance Toner again. I have sensitive skin, but I worked my way up to using this daily. Initially I didn't apply it over the most sensitive parts of my face, and I immediately rinsed my face after using this toner. This was more of a precaution since I never had a reaction. Now I use it as part of my evening skincare routine. After cleansing my face (usually with the DERMA E CBD cleanser), I pat it dry, and then I apply this with a reusable cotton pad. I let my skin air dry for about a minute before continuing with my routine. I love how my skin feels and how it looks. Most acids are too strong for my skin, but I've never had an issue with this one.

I've been using this toner for about 4 months now and I don't see myself ever using a different type of toner. I have a health condition that can really dry out my skin, and when that happens it makes my skin so much more hydrated and I feel so much more comfortable. During the months where my skin tends to go more to the oily side, I feel like my skin is still very well balanced. The ingredients like glycolic acid, hyaluronic acid, and pycnogenol are amazing. Different parts of this contributes different benefits; Exfoliating, hydrating, anti-inflammatory, reduces redness, prevents UV ray damage and UVB wrinkles, and reduces melasma. It definitely smells like rose/botanical, but the smell becomes less and less noticeable with time regardless of how you feel about it (I'm personally totally fine with how it smells). I'd personally recommend this toner for people who are trying to prevent aging and are aiming to balance their skin hydration. Anyone who has more irritated or inflamed skin may also benefit from using this. If your skin is super sensitive, you may want to have another toner on standby, but this has so many soothing agents in it I think you'll be fine.

Scent is rose, not strong, just perfect for me. Brightens skin, tightens and not drying. Excellent for day and night. I used to wear the vitamin c micellar water which was perfect for my skin. I don't think it's being sold anymore. However This product is a great substitute.

I did not notice any difference in acne or overall texture and the product would get a crust around the opening where product would dispense. I felt that was odd. I used the whole bottle because I wanted to give it a shot but honestly I was glad when it was finally gone. I'm glad it's worked for others but did nothing for my skin.

My former toner was too harsh for my skin and was causing it to dry out even more, which also caused my skin texture to show more (I will admit it's great for clearing up acne). Now that I'm using this Derma E toner, my skin is clear, glowing, and so dang healthy looking! I feel so pretty in my own skin again. I'm not having to carry around travel-size moisturizers at all time anymore. Definitely worth trying out. Oh and one last thing...this toner reminds me of the Fresh Kombucha Essence. Smells and feels just like it.

To anyone who is new to skincare and to comment on the review that says false advertising...there are certain acids specifically aha/bhas that in order to use them you HAVE to wear sunscreen spf 30 or higher every day after exposure these acids in my opinion you should wear sunscreen everyday NO MATTER WHAT! But the main ingredient in this toner is glycolic acid an AHA that significantly increases the skins sensitivity to uv rays (sun) this product can help minimize the texture on the skin so when informed and used correctly it can be very beneficial in skincare:)

avis.titre: FALSE ADVERTISING! "Sunburn Alert"  Do not buy!
avis.texte: I couldn't believe when I received this in the mail and the REAL packaging for the product says: "Sunburn Alert: This product contains an AHA that may increase your skin's sensitivity to the sun and particularly the possibility of sunburn. Limit sun exposure while using this product and for a week afterwards". Reputable skincare products should not increase risk of sun damage. They should prevent sun damage. I can't believe the picture on the website shows a FALSE back label that conveniently omits the sunburn alert. We are being lied to. DO NOT BUY!!!!!
